problems.title: The subspace topology
problems.statement: Let $A\subseteq X$. Prove that $\{A\cap U:U\text{ is open in }X\}$ is a topology on $A$. Explain why it is the coarsest topology on $A$ that makes the inclusion $i:A\hookrightarrow X$ continuous.

problems.title: The universal property of a product
problems.statement: Let $f:Z\to X\times Y$. Prove that $f$ is continuous if and only if both coordinate maps $\pi_X\circ f:Z\to X$ and $\pi_Y\circ f:Z\to Y$ are continuous.

problems.title: Using the product topology
problems.statement: Let $f,g:Z\to\mathbb R$ be continuous. Prove that the map $z\mapsto(f(z),g(z))$ from $Z$ to $\mathbb R^2$ is continuous. Use this and appropriate continuous maps $\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R$ to deduce that $f+g$ and $fg$ are continuous.
